title: The drones were orbs from the sea, now over Europe
summary: Chris Bledsoe tells of The drones were orbs from the sea, now over Europe, about 2024-2025 at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: These drones supposedly drones that show up. Those aren't drones.

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he attracts UFOs, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about the so-called drones that people reported seeing in the skies over the United States in 2024 and later over Europe. Bledsoe says they are not drones at all, but orbs, balls of light that come up from the sea. If true, the lights people took for machines would be something else entirely.
